//! Splits a recipe expression into tokens.
//!
//! The tokenizer never allocates for a token: each [`Token`] borrows its text
//! from the input.

use std::iter::Peekable;
use std::str::CharIndices;

/// A token and the text it covers.
#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Clone, Copy)]
pub enum Token<'a> {
    /// A name, such as `collections`.
    Ident(&'a str),
    /// A quoted string, without its quotes.
    Str(&'a str),
    /// A single punctuation character.
    Punct(char),
}

/// Reads tokens from an expression.
pub struct Tokenizer<'a> {
    src: &'a str,
    chars: Peekable<CharIndices<'a>>,
}

impl<'a> Tokenizer<'a> {
    /// Starts reading `src` from its first byte.
    pub fn new(src: &'a str) -> Self {
        Tokenizer { src, chars: src.char_indices().peekable() }
    }

    /// Skips spaces and `#` comments, which run to the end of the line.
    fn skip_trivia(&mut self) {
        while let Some(&(_, c)) = self.chars.peek() {
            match c {
                ' ' | '\t' | '\n' => {
                    self.chars.next();
                }
                '#' => {
                    // A comment in the expression language, not in Rust.
                    while let Some((_, c)) = self.chars.next() {
                        if c == '\n' {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                _ => break,
            }
        }
    }
}

impl<'a> Iterator for Tokenizer<'a> {
    type Item = Token<'a>;

    fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
        self.skip_trivia();
        let (start, c) = self.chars.next()?;
        if c == '"' {
            // Find the closing quote; an unterminated string runs to the end.
            let end = self
                .chars
                .find(|&(_, c)| c == '"')
                .map_or(self.src.len(), |(i, _)| i);
            return Some(Token::Str(&self.src[start + 1..end]));
        }
        if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_' {
            let mut end = start + c.len_utf8();
            while let Some(&(i, c)) = self.chars.peek() {
                if !(c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '_') {
                    break;
                }
                end = i + c.len_utf8();
                self.chars.next();
            }
            return Some(Token::Ident(&self.src[start..end]));
        }
        Some(Token::Punct(c)) /* anything else stands alone */
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    // The string "// here" is a token, not a comment.
    #[test]
    fn reads_a_string_holding_slashes() {
        let tokens: Vec<_> = Tokenizer::new("name = \"// here\"").collect();
        assert_eq!(tokens, vec![Token::Ident("name"), Token::Punct('='), Token::Str("// here")]);
    }
}
